summary: Phase 6 v0.1 close-out acceptance run — ALL green. Backend pytest total 153/153 (119 prior + 34 new phase-6 acceptance tests in /app/backend/tests/test_phase6_acceptance.py). Coverage: auth hardening (cookies httpOnly+Secure, SameSite Lax user / Strict admin, CSRF double-submit 403 without header / bypass with matching header / bypass on Bearer, logout revokes sessions row, /me works cookie-only, NO auth token in localStorage), startup guards (phase=6, ci_test_issuer_enabled=true, prod_mode=false, seeder loaded 4 feature flags, no duplicate operation-id crash), admin console 7 tabs, sealed masking literal '🔒 masked (sealed sensitivity)' rendered with NO unmask control anywhere (support + admin), mandatory audit-on-view row, refund with reason enum + audit + invalid_reason 400, feature flag toggle + audit, manual queue resolve (admin) / 403 (support), billing catalog + usage meters + coupon + checkout + cancel in ≤2 clicks, privacy consents + revoke → feed 403 consent_required + grant_url + export bundle + soft-delete + login 403 account_deletion_pending, 14-gate enumeration on fixture-ead 9/6 geometry, submission_receipts unique index + concurrent race (1 ok + 1 DuplicateKeyError), LinkedIn/Indeed/Handshake 409 route_unavailable_platform_policy, SAMPLE excluded from user metrics. 13 screenshots persisted to /app/test_reports/p6-*.png + devtools evidence PNG. Human-readable A–I report at /app/test_reports/p6-acceptance-run.md.

minor.issue: counts.audit_events is always 0 because audit rows are written to the 'audit_logs' collection (audit/service.py:17), not 'audit_events'. Rename the counts key or query the correct collection. 1-line fix in domains/admin/service.py counts loop.

audit_trail is fetched from 'audit_events' with filter {actor_id: user_id} but audit rows live in 'audit_logs' with field 'actor'. Result: audit_trail is always []. Fix at privacy/service.py:172 — change collection to 'audit_logs' and filter to {'actor': user_id}.

issues: Modal header overlaps with the tabs strip in some viewports (see p6-user-detail-support.png / p6-user-detail-admin.png) — the sticky admin tabs are visible behind the modal overlay. Not a blocker; z-index of modal is > overlay but < tabs strip. Add z-index bump on the modal container.

action_items: (minor) Fix 'audit_events' → 'audit_logs' naming in admin/service.py health counts and privacy/service.py export bundle audit_trail fetch (both 1-line changes).

(nice-to-have) Extend admin user-detail modal to also render eligibility_profiles fields with sealed masking — currently only claims are shown, and none of the fixture-ead claims are sensitivity='sealed' by default so the mask literal only appears when the founder deliberately marks a claim sealed. Sealed values in eligibility_profiles (opt_end, itar_excluded, etc.) are not surfaced today.
(cosmetic) Raise z-index of Admin user-detail modal container so the tabs strip doesn't peek through the overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `_assert_unique_operation_ids` falls back to `route.name` when `operation_id` is unset. This is fine today (no collisions) but two truly anonymous routes could still collide. Consider requiring an explicit operation_id per route.

CSRF middleware BYPASSES on any Authorization: Bearer header. This is spec-intentional (Bearer is scoped to CI + internal), but a compromised Bearer would sidestep CSRF entirely. Mitigation is CI_TEST_ISSUER_ENABLED=false in prod, enforced by the startup guard. Explicit note is documented already — no action.
admin/service.py::_mask_sealed reads claim.sensitivity as string; if a legacy claim writes sensitivity as {'level':'sealed'} it will silently NOT mask. Consider a stricter type contract on write.

rca of the issue: N/A — all founder amendments and A–I acceptance items pass. Minor naming inconsistency (audit_events vs audit_logs) is documented above; RCA: legacy field naming from an earlier phase where the collection was called audit_events was renamed to audit_logs in the write path but the read-path references in admin/health and privacy/export were not updated in the same commit.
